segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are mixed: several long-term users with dry or dry-and-sensitive skin report a good glow with no problem from dryness, but there is real dissent, one with dry/combination skin says it became so drying and irritating after a couple of weeks that she switched products, and another with extremely dry skin says it did feel a bit drying despite loving what it did for her acne.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination, often combination-dehydrated, skin broadly say the pads keep their skin from getting dry and help even out texture and blemish marks, though a few in this group specifically note little to no visible effect on their blemish marks despite the hydration benefit.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the largest group and mostly report the pads calm their skin without stinging or redness, including several who call it the gentlest pad they have tried and one with eczema who never had a problem; dissent exists too, with a few reporting initial irritation that faded after about a week and some cautioning it can sting if paired with an exfoliating toner or rubbed too hard.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are mostly positive, calling it a must-buy that leaves skin smoother and brighter and clears blemishes, though one reviewer cautions the mask version of this product might cause some oily-skinned users to see extra sebum production.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who use this for blemishes report real improvement, cleared active breakouts and faded post-acne marks or scars, sometimes within days, but there is significant dissent: several say it had little to no effect on their blemish marks, one broke out using it and stopped, and one found it helped her acne short-term before irritating her skin. There is also an ingredient-specific caution, one detailed reviewer says the fermented ingredients can trigger breakouts for hormonal-acne sufferers, while another credits the product with helping her skin recover after a fungal-acne episode.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the pads as generously soaked and hydrating, keeping skin from drying out through the day, but a consistent minority, especially reviewers with very dry skin, say the hydration doesn't last after it absorbs and that they need to layer a moisturizer on top right away.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say the pads have a calming, cooling effect that visibly reduces it, including on reddish or acne-prone skin, and several with sensitive skin report no stinging at all; the dissent is mostly mechanical rather than chemical, with a number warning the gauze surface itself can feel rough or stinging if rubbed vigorously, paired with an exfoliating toner, or pressed directly onto active blemishes.
concerns.barrier: The reviewers who specifically mention their skin barrier say this product was part of restoring it after it broke down from an overly complicated routine, crediting the fermented ingredients with supporting barrier repair.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible fading of acne marks, scars, or discoloration with regular use, in some cases within a day or two and in others gradually over weeks or months; the dissent comes from a few who found the effect on marks disappointing or barely noticeable despite otherwise liking the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mostly find the pads work well for them and help balance oil and hydration, though one reviewer cautions that the mask version of this product may cause some oily-skinned users to see extra sebum production.

extraits.titre: Very  good depending on the type of skin you have
extraits.texte: I have eczema, dry but oily skin, and am acne prone… yes ik it sucks. This is a very good product for hydration (dry skin and oily skin) especially good for people with oily skin because typically your skin is oily because its not hydrated enough so it produces more oil to try and combat that. I obviously have sensitive skin (eczema) and have never had a problem woth this, same goes with being acne prone. HOWEVER, if you have HORMONAL acne (i dont) then i would NOT recommend this product for you as it contains Polyglyceryl-10 Oleate, Saccharomyces Ferment, and Lactobacillus Ferment which are known ingredients that commonly cause a breakout im hormonal acne (typically those deep painful pimples). If you are jusy acne prone (like me) then it should not do anything bad to your skin unless you have a sensitivity or are allergic to one of the ingredients.

My skin type: Combination­dry, sensitive, with blemishes and uneven texture in the T­zone I used this product morning and night daily. The formula is lightweight and refreshing, not heavy at all, but it doesn't leave my skin feeling dry either ­ it strikes the perfect balance. When I briefly switched to another product, I immediately noticed blemishes, uneven texture, and deep pimples appearing. So I went back to this one, and wow! In just one day, my deep pimples reduced from 5 to 3, and the uneven texture and blemishes that were too numerous to count almost completely disappeared! There was also this stubborn acne scar I'd had for about six months that vanished after using this, and many of my dark spots faded too. Another bonus: if I apply this before makeup, it has a cooling effect and makes my foundation go on flawlessly! I have a graduation photo shoot coming up soon, and I was really worried about my skin acting up, but after using this product, those worries have completely disappeared!!!! Mediheal, you're a lifesaver! Since both sides of the pad have a gauze texture, it can be a bit harsh for exfoliating. If you have sensitive skin, definitely use it as a mask instead of for exfoliation!

Effective for soothing blemish marks: You can definitely see acne scars gradually fading. It's not dramatically quick, but with consistent use, you'll notice visible improvement. 'Almost no irritation: Even on days when my skin was super sensitive, I could use it comfortably without any tingling or redness. It's gentle enough for daily use. 'Great for removing dead skin cells: After one use, my face feels smooth. When used before makeup, it really helps the makeup apply beautifully. 'Generous pad size: The pads are large enough to cover the entire face in one go. They're also great for leaving on cheeks as a mini mask. 'Slightly lacking in hydration: The essence isn't bad, but after it's fully absorbed, it feels a bit dry, so you need to apply moisturizer right away. 'Not an instant fix for blemishes: It doesn't seem to have a significant effect on calming active breakouts, but it does work on existing blemish marks. 'Has a slight scent: It's not unscented and has a subtle fragrance. I didn't mind it, but those sensitive to scents might find it noticeable. Using it the night before applying makeup makes a huge difference: It thoroughly removes dead skin cells, leaving your skin texture smooth. The difference is especially noticeable when used the night before an important day. For irritated skin days, try refrigerating the pads for an extra soothing effect: Placing the cool pad on cheeks or chin for about 5 minutes seems to calm redness.
